assertions.claim: The item does not discuss whether to use sex hormones, only how — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 这条不讨论该不该用，只讨论怎么用

assertions.claim: Transgender women (vast majority on estrogen) have markedly more venous thrombosis than matched controls — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 跨性别女性（绝大多数在用雌激素）的静脉血栓比同龄对照明显多

assertions.claim: Those starting therapy during follow-up show larger gaps in thrombosis and ischemic stroke; no overall difference for myocardial infarction — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 随访期间才开始用药的那部分人，血栓和缺血性中风的差距更明显；心梗总体没看出差别

assertions.claim: Thrombosis is checkable and preventable in advance only if someone monitors regularly; the buy-online-and-self-titrate path lacks that person — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 血栓是能查、能提前干预的，前提是有人在定期给你查

assertions.claim: Evidence for transgender men is insufficient for conclusions — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 跨性别男性的证据不足以下结论

assertions.claim: Applies to all sex-hormone uses (contraception, menopausal HT, testosterone): risk arises in the unmonitored segment, not in the motive — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 凡是自己网购、参照网帖调量、不查血栓和肝肾指标的，风险都出在「没人监测」这一段，而不是出在用药动机上

assertions.claim: The proper path in China is assessment, prescription and follow-up at endocrinology or the relevant specialty of a proper medical institution — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 国内规范路径是去正规医疗机构的内分泌科或相应专科评估、开方、随访
